plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Offers to shape a long, loose prompt (250+ words) into a short German four-part brief (Aufgabe, Zweck, Leitplanken, Fertig wenn), asking up to three questions about real gaps first

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt. 90 s before a chat of 100k+ tokens goes cold, asks the handoff mod for a handoff by itself. Keep warm pings the cache in the background so it does not go cold

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 280k tokens asks whether to write a handoff (Write handoff / Not now / Hide); writes one by itself when Cache Clock asks before the cache goes cold. Shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs to ~/.claude/mods-logs/handoff.log and saves a draft first
